Thanks for the quick intro earlier — I spoke with Daniel (CTO) and he asked for a short executive-level demo of Redwood tailored to SummitAI's scaling and governance needs. He wants the VP/CIO-level sponsor there to understand SLAs, private deployment options, and expected unit economics.

Would you and the appropriate Redwood exec be available for a 30–40 minute slot next week? Our preferred windows are:
- Wed Jan 18: 11:00–11:40 PT
- Thu Jan 19: 09:00–09:40 PT or 14:00–14:40 PT

If you can hold one of those and loop in your VP or someone who can speak to enterprise/compliance, that would be ideal. I'll invite Daniel + our Head of Data Ops.

Thanks — happy to be flexible on timing.
